title: Decode Late, Multiply Once: Rethinking the Dot Product for Quantized Weights
abstract: arXiv:2610.31913v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large neural networks are increasingly deployed with 1-4 bit weights and 16- or 32-bit activations, yet their dot products still use one multiplier per element. We show that a length-n dot product with k-bit weight codes can be computed with n+2^k additions and at most 2^k decodes and 2^k multiplications. Each weight code is used directly as an address offset that selects one of 2^k accumulators; each activation is added into the selected accumulator; and the accumulated sums are decoded and multiplied only once, at the end, in a fused decode-and-multiply step. The decoded weight vector is never formed. The refactoring is exact for integer arithmetic, works with integer or floating-point operands and with arbitrary, including nonlinear, decoders, and extends to group-wise scales and to matrix and tensor products. The multiplier count falls by n/2^k, while total arithmetic energy improves by a smaller, bounded factor that we quantify with

translated_title: 延迟解码，只乘一次：重新思考量化权重的点积运算
translated_abstract: 大型神经网络越来越多地以1-4比特权重和16或32比特激活值的形式部署，然而它们的点积运算仍然对每个元素使用一个乘法器。我们证明，一个长度为n、权重编码为k比特的点积可以用n+2^k次加法、至多2^k次解码和至多2^k次乘法来计算。每个权重编码被直接用作地址偏移量，从2^k个累加器中选择一个；每个激活值被加到所选的累加器中；累积的和只在最后于一个融合的“解码-乘法”步骤中解码并相乘一次。解码后的权重向量从头到尾都不需要被实际构建。这种重构对于整数运算是精确等价的，适用于整数或浮点操作数以及任意（包括非线性）的解码器，并可扩展到分组缩放以及矩阵和张量乘积。乘法器的数量减少为原来的1/(n/2^k)，而总运算能耗则以一个较小但有界的因子得到改善，我们对此进行了量化……
tldr: 该论文提出“延迟解码、只乘一次”的点积重构方法：将k比特权重编码直接用作地址偏移来选择2^k个累加器之一，最后统一进行融合的解码与乘法，从而在整数运算下精确等价的前提下，将量化权重点积的乘法器数量减少n/2^k倍，并支持任意（含非线性）解码器和矩阵/张量乘积。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a "decode late, multiply once" refactoring of the dot product, where k-bit weight codes act as address offsets routing additions into 2^k accumulators, reducing multiplier count by a factor of n/2^k while remaining exactly equivalent for integer arithmetic and generalizing to arbitrary (including nonlinear) decoders and matrix/tensor products.
